description: This file defines the server-side code-behind for the AdminCourseQueue page in an ASP.NET WebForms application. It includes event handlers for page load, button clicks for navigation between pages, and handling the selection change of a GridView component to store data in session and navigate accordingly.

classes.name: AdminCourseQueue
classes.description: Code-behind class for the AdminCourseQueue ASP.NET page handling server-side events such as navigation, session management, and grid view selection change.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Event handler for when the page loads; currently does nothing.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Handles clicking the 'home' button; transfers control to the AdminPanel page.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Placeholder for profile button click event; currently does nothing.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Handles clicking the 'Leaderboard' button; transfers control to the AdminLeaderboard page.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Handles clicking the 'logout' button; transfers control to the LoginPage.

methods.name: GridView2_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Handles selection change in a GridView; stores selected row's second cell text in session and transfers control to the AdminCourseQueue page.
